steps.label: plt.subplots(nrows, ncols)
steps.sub: A grid of related plots side by side, saved with fig.savefig

code:
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))

ax.plot(x, np.cos(x), label="cos(x)")
ax.plot(x, np.sin(x), label="sin(x)")

ax.set_title("Two reference waveforms")
ax.set_xlabel("x (radians)")
ax.legend()
caption: label= on each plot() call feeds legend() — without it, a series won't show up there.

code:
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4))

axes[0].plot(x, np.sin(x))
axes[0].set_title("sin(x)")

axes[1].plot(x, np.cos(x))
axes[1].set_title("cos(x)")

fig.tight_layout()
caption: The standard way to put a probability distribution next to the circuit that produced it.
